decisions.reason: Despite no later website observation, this certified HVAC plate heat exchanger line is very close to the firm's core exchanger, engineering, and service knowledge, so management would more likely retain and refine it than withdraw it.

The marine box cooler system builds directly on established marine cooling capabilities and had early signs of strong market acceptance, so a firm with this knowledge base would usually continue it unless clear negative evidence emerged.

This marine cooling unit fits the firm's installed-base marine business and can be improved through service learning and in-house R&D, which lowers the likelihood of withdrawal even though later public evidence is sparse.

The compact oil cooler is close to the existing thermal-management portfolio, but weaker visible follow-up evidence makes it somewhat more exposed to portfolio pruning than the stronger marine offerings.

Finned tubes for air coolers extend the firm's established component and air-cooling know-how, so absorptive capacity is high enough that management would generally keep developing the product rather than exit quickly.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes rely on core thermal-engineering knowledge and benefit from the firm's own R&D and research cooperation capabilities, making continued commercialization more likely than withdrawal.
